status: Exploratory follow-up specified after prior point estimates were examined; freeze required before new calculations
scope: Working-design uncertainty for all four existing AS01 fits and one-at-a-time release of each AS01 anchor for S4; no new data/sample, clinical or causal claims

variance.method: Observed-Hessian M-estimator sandwich, with within-hearing group n_g/W_g normalization and empirical reference distribution both linearized; covariance includes their cross term
variance.score_formula: s_i=d negative log p_i/dtheta; U=sum_g(n_g/N)*sbar_g; u_i=D_i/N*((sbar_g-U)+(n_g/W_g)*w_i*(s_i-sbar_g)); thetaIF_i=-A^{-1}u_i
variance.target_formula: tau=sum_g(n_g/N)*fbar_g; v_i=D_i/N*((fbar_g-tau)+(n_g/W_g)*w_i*(f_i-fbar_g)); totalIF_i=v_i+J*thetaIF_i. Fixed age/sex profiles have v_i=0.
variance.design: Household sums combine both hearing groups, zero contributions for domain-excluded cases/households, all6217 households centered within9GOR; WR approximation with H_h/(H_h-1) finite-cluster correction, no FPC. Published final survey weights treated fixed.
variance.official_basis: Existing verified ELSA user guide table5.1/footnote4 recommends household IDs and GOR from wave3; this implements that public-data design recommendation, not reconstruction of original geographical PSUs or weight-estimation uncertainty.
variance.tie_sensitivity: lex_last; only three mixed-GOR households change whole-household stratum; same scores/point estimates, no refit
variance.intervals: Pointwise95% t(df6208) for16 average item targets and96 prespecified profiles. Additionally Bonferroni95% intervals across16 average targets (planned family retained even if some fail). No p values or significance-based model choice; profile intervals not simultaneous or interaction tests.
variance.fixed_reference_diagnostic: Retain parameter-only SE as a diagnostic alongside primary total SE; not substitute it based on narrower width
variance.gate: If either Q fails stationarity/Hessian checks, any mean or fixed-profile SE fails2% stability, or Newton target correction exceeds max(1e-5,0.05*SE), suppress scientific CIs for that model and preserve all diagnostics. No unplanned refinement/refit.
variance.limits: Asymptotic working-design inference conditional on models/anchors and observed complete-case domain; no new coverage simulation or formal design calibration; not robust to false-anchor scientific meaning or unidentified models

anchors.constraints: Release all hearing/age/sex direct intercept and log-loading coefficients for exactly one original anchor. Keep all8 items and M2 factor structure. Each factor retains at least1 anchor; numerical local-identification gates still required.
anchors.initialization: Transfer common named parameters from prior S4; new coefficients0. Start2 fixed0.08*sin(1..p) perturbation clipped0.001 inside unchanged bounds. No choosing starting anchor based on results.
anchors.outputs: All attempts; all5 nonanchor reference contrasts per fit; original4-target comparison with S4; numerical diagnostics and local item/pair residuals. No intervals for release fits or ranges. Failed scientific contrasts suppressed, diagnostic values retained distinctly.
anchors.interpretation: Limited one-at-a-time assumption-release sensitivity, not comprehensive anchor validation. Remaining anchors stay assumed invariant. Cross-anchor contrasts include changes of reference calibration; no bias decomposition or best-anchor selection.

privacy: Authorized local participant data and pattern/household scores remain RAM-only; no participant, pattern, household or latent-score export. Aggregate matrices, results and logs only; network disabled in computation.
